Four marble Pantheon stage scenes for arez, one coherent series in white marble on warm ivory, soft daylight from the upper left, a fluted marble column in frame, glowing luminous threads (owner-authorized red for the red team), no readable text. Ares holds an upright spear with its blade to the sky and a round shield; his son Deimoz drives the attack on a small marble tablet that stands for the code. recon: Deimoz leans in to study the code-tablet, no threads fired. exploit: Deimoz fires a glowing red thread into the code-tablet. prove: Ares raises the round shield whose face shows a glowing line turning from red to green. lock: the code-tablet is bound by a glowing green thread and sealed, the regression locked.
